chatgptPrompt: Create a Shorts cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Subject: a cutaway of a white cup filling with light blue water, a stack of thin green lines in the empty air above the water showing a standing sound wave, a thin ruler at the left. Composition: cup centred in a vertical frame, the air column in the upper half. Lighting and treatment: soft daylight; a daylight lab or an everyday room, clean and exact, cream background #E9E3D3, ink #1B1E24, one blue #2F5BFF accent, soft strobe-ghost stamps, premium editorial science documentary look, clearly a code-rendered illustration rather than a photograph. Mood: wonder. Text: No text. Scientific accuracy: the empty air above the water behaves like a pipe closed at one end; a shorter pipe has a higher pitch, so the pitch rises as the cup fills. Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real photograph or a news image. Style: distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art. Keep the focal point and any text inside the centre safe area, clear of the bottom 25% and the right-hand buttons.
